context: Pre-earnings sentiment and analyst reactions to Q1 2026 delivery miss

delivery_miss_reaction.initial_reaction: Stock fell ~4% to $365.03 following Q1 delivery report
delivery_miss_reaction.narrative: Biggest delivery miss yet. 50,000+ cars in inventory. Bears see structural demand problem; bulls say one-time inventory build.

key_risks: Gross margin compression from inventory overhang
Revenue miss vs. wide estimate range
key_catalysts: Musk announcement on stepping back from DOGE

cramer_view.comment: Tesla can't trade on hopes forever. Consensus expects sales and earnings to grow again in 2026/2027, but Q1 delivery results show YoY production decline.

historical_earnings_reactions.note: Optimus robots on track for year-end production confirmed

options_market_implied.note: Wide EPS range ($0.22-$0.54) suggests options market pricing large move
options_market_implied.implied_move: To be confirmed closer to earnings
